connector.name: Dear Claude
connector.registryDescription: Spawn Claude Code instances from 6 platforms when 'Dear Claude' is mentioned.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package dear-claude. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sns45 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
